entries.label: Silo Entrance — cour du premier duel de Null
entries.scene: Reconstruct the enclosed outdoor concrete service courtyard at Silo Entrance in Portable Ops where the FIRST Null boss encounter occurs. Preserve the greenish weathered concrete paving and walls, large rectangular dark olive corrugated cargo crates stacked two-high with narrow yellow horizontal bands, thick concrete square support piers, a raised concrete walkway/ramp behind the open yard with simple pale metal railings, small red-brown utility doors under rectangular lamps, the hard yellow-green daylight. Use the open yard views rather than the underside-camera view. Keep the bulky simple PSP architecture. No electrical transformers from the second Null encounter, no giant silo rocket or invented missile.
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE opaque wide 16:9 static fighting-game stage background plate for CQC, closely grounded in the supplied original PSP/game screenshots. Input images are REFERENCE SCREENSHOTS or chronological reference contact sheets only. Output one continuous environment, never a grid or collage. Ignore all characters, menus, HUD, cards, facecam, video branding and subtitles in the references. notes: Cour du premier duel contrôlée : béton verdâtre, caisse nervurée à bande jaune, rampe supérieure et portes brunes.
